en.description:
At bunq, we're not just building a banking app; we're reshaping how people around the world experience financial freedom. As a (Senior) iOS Developer, you’ll be instrumental in crafting and maintaining cutting-edge mobile applications that elevate our users' banking journeys. Collaborate with our dynamic team to deliver a seamless, innovative, and user-friendly experience on the iOS platform.

Take Ownership

  • Develop and maintain scalable iOS architecture, ensuring efficiency and a seamless user experience using Swift and iOS SDK.

  • Integrate and optimize REST APIs, managing authentication, error handling, and data flow for smooth performance.

  • Enhance CI/CD and testing automation, maintaining fast release cycles and ensuring robust app quality.

  • Develop new features and fix bugs proactively, keeping performance sharp and delivering a seamless experience for Eva.

en.description:
At bunq , we move fast, launching products, entering new markets, and onboarding partners across the globe. Behind every partnership that makes users’ banking experience better, there's a contract. We need a sharp, senior lawyer who owns that process end to end, and in doing so, gets a front-row seat to every corner of bunq's business, from product launches to market expansions.

Up for this? Kick off your application by taking our assessment and find out if bunq is your perfect match.

Take ownership

As our Medior Legal Counsel, you'll get exposure to all areas of legal at bunq, from product launches to regulatory changes to new market expansions. On top of that, you own the following:

  • Be the go-to person for every third-party contract at bunq, from payment processors to tech vendors, making sure we move fast without cutting corners.

  • Take our AI contract review tool (Luminance) to the next level, building smarter workflows that handle more, faster, with you setting the bar for what gets signed.

  • Give bunq's leadership a clear, real-time picture of our third-party risk, so decisions get made on facts, not gut feeling.

offers.locations_question: What is your preferred work location?

en.description:
At bunq, we Make Life Easy, and so does our content. As our Copywriting Intern, you will contribute to making every line across our ads, website/blogs, and social media clear, helpful, and actionable for our users. You’ll help craft messaging that grabs attention and support the content team by turning ideas, insights, and trends into content that actually performs.

Ready to help us turn words into impact? 🚀

Take ownership

  • Contribute ideas and copy variations for ads and social campaigns, helping the team test and learn faster ✍️

  • Turn competitor and social trend research into actionable insights — identify patterns, spot opportunities, and propose messaging angles that differentiate bunq 🔎

  • Create and manage engaging blog and website content to support brand awareness and marketing goals.

  • Support campaign testing by proposing A/B ideas for headlines, hooks, and messaging variations to learn what resonates across markets 📊

  • Write structured drafts for ads, social posts, and website content that support product launches and high-impact campaigns 📣

  • Help keep messaging clear, sharp, and focused on real value for our users ✨
